svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.colombia-flag-layout-context", "design_basis": "Independent integer-grid flag frame and regions, not converted paper pixels.", "source_master_path": "tactile/masters/education/geography/flag-layouts/colombia-flag-layout-context.svg", "source_master_sha256": "e9e7cd6e9c286b78ca74b12f5cabc635908ec9f472f8262998de97153b8e1cf1", "original_teaching_context": "Introduced plain Colombia flag layout: yellow upper half, blue third quarter and red bottom quarter, without arms or inscription. Frame [180, 120]mm on [220, 160]mm page. Boundaries convey declared band regions;colour andidentity depend on the external key. Accessible teacher/audio key introduces colombia,orientation horizontal top to bottom,colour roles yellow-upper, blue-centre, red-lower. 180\u00d7120mm independent frame. Three horizontal fields: yellow y0..60,blue y60..90,red y90..120. Ratios2:1:1. Sharedseamsaty60/y90drawnonce; no seal,armedforcesvariant, star,pole,fringe,coat or lettering. ColombianForeignMinistryCircular36/2021indexedfullnormativeparagraphread; directbody403. It reproduces namedcolourorder andhalf/quarter/quarter band proportions. Frameaspectratio remains an explicit teaching selection; no exact official fabrication/civil-militaryvariant or colourimetric certification. This plain named flag context is not automatically merged with another national identity merely because geometry/colourroles can be shared. External accessible country/colour key required;grey line geometry does not inherently encode hue.", "physical_evaluation": "pending", "colour_key_required": true}
